book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu andamiha mundu joatengwike
Yesu akajingi mu ngalawa, na kulomboka kabheti nhwanga kukelabhuka ku muchi waki.

Panihapa bhandu bhakandeti mundu jumu joatengwiki, koni bhungoniki panani ja chitala. Yesu paakaweni uhobhalelu wabhu, akampwaghi mundu joatengwiki jola, “Lipekya mtima mwanango! Ulekakiwi mahoku ghako.”
Panihapa bhabhola bhakumu bha Shelia bhakatumbwi kuholalela mu mitima jabhu, “Mundu ajoju antondo Chapanga!”
Yesu akaghamanyi maholalelu ghabhu, akapwaghite, “Bho, maghambu kiki muholale mahakau mu mitima jinu?
Bho, laleku lelipepwiki nakanopi, kupwagha, ‘Ulekakiwi mahoku ghaku,’ au kupwagha, ‘Jemaje na ujendaje?’

Henu, mbala mumanyaye kubha Mwana waka Mundu abhi na uwezu pundema wa kubhalekake bhandu mahoku.” Panihapa akampwaghi mundu jotengwiki jola, “Jemaje, na utola chitala chaku, na ujendaje kunyumba jaku.”
Mundu joatengwiki jola akajemiki, na kubhuja kunyumba jaki.
Bhandu bhokapi pabhaghaweni ghanihagha, bhakakangichi na kujoghopa, bhakundumbali Chapanga joabhapeki bhandu uwezu wa ntundu agho.
Yesu andoha Matayo
Yesu paakabhi abhoka panihapa, akumbweni mundu jumu joalowakeka Matayo, atemi munyumba ja kubhonganela kode. Yesu akampwaghile, “Unyengalyaje.” Matayo akajemiki, na kunjengalela.
Yesu paakabhi atemi kunyumba jaka Matayo kula chilebhi, bhajopa kode bhamaheli na bhana mahoku bhakahikiki kutama papamu na Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki.
Mafalisayo bhakumu pabhaghaweni ghanihagha, bhakabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu, “Bho, maghambu kike mbola winu akula chilebhi papamu na bhajopa kode na bhana mahoku?”
Yesu paakajowini, akabhayangiki, “Bhandu bhangakulwala ngachebhumpala sing'anga, nambu bhabhumpala sing'anga nde bhala bhabhalwala.

Njendaje mkalibholaye panani ja Malembu Mahuhu moghapwaghila, ‘Mbala chiha, wala nga nyambiku.’ Ngachenhikiki kubhaloha bhandu bhambone bhanyengalyaje, nambu bhandu bhana mahoku bhaghaleka mahoku ghabhu.”
Lilalukilu panani ja kukonga kula chilebhe
Lichobha limu bhabhulwa bhaka Yohana Mbatizaji bhakanjendi Yesu, na kundalukila, “Bho, maghambu kiki tepani na Mafalisayo tukonga kula chilebi, nambu bhabhulwa bhaku ngachebhakonga?”

Yesu akabhayangiki, “Bho, bhandu bhabhakokakiki paukwati bhapalika le kulela chikahi bambo ukwati abhi papamu nabhu? Ngabhela! Nambu lichobha analihikaye bambo ukwati anaabhohakika pachilanda jabhu, panihapa nde pabhikonga kula chilebhi.
“Nga mundu joaloka chilaka chahenu panani ja ingobhu ja mwandi. Maghambu chilaka hechi anachikachula ingobhu ja mwandi jela, na papakakachwiki pala, anapajonjikika nakanopi.

Wala bhandu ngachebhabheka divai jahenu mu mifuku ja chingokolu cha mwandi. Anabhatendiki bhenibhela, mifuku ja chingokolu jela jitenda kukachuka na divai kujitika, na mifuku ja ingokolu heyi anajiyonangikaje. Nambu divai jahenu jibhekakeka mu mifuku ja ingokolu jahenu, panihapa nde yokapi anaitama wichu.”
Mwali joapotile na mbomba mtamwa

Yesu paakabhi alonge ghanihagha, chiongozi jumu wa Bhayahude akahikike, akunchikamili na kupwagha, “Kamwali wangu apotile esajeno, nambu pepakoku uhikaye ubheka chiwoku chaku panani jaki, najombi apataje kubha mwomi.”
Yesu akajemiki, na kunjengalela, na bhabhulwa bhaki na bhombi bhakunjengalile.
Mabhu jumu mtamwa wa kupita mwahi kwa chikahi cha hyaka komi na ibheli, akanjengali Yesu cha kunyuma, na kunkamula nkungilu wa ingobhu jaka Yesu.
Maghambu akapwaghiki muntima waki, “Ananunkamwi pena ingobhu jaki, ananamaje.”
Yesu akang'anambwiki na kumbona, akampwaghile, “Kamwali wangu, ulipekya mtima! Uhobhalelu waku ukulamihe.” Palapala kamwali jola akalamiki.
Yesu paakahikiki kunyumba jaka chiongozi jola, na paakabhaweni bhayemba filimbi na lipogha la bhandu bhakalapula njobhela,
akabhapwaghile, “Mbokanyaje pambane! Kamwali joni ngacheapotile, nambu atehi pe kughonela.” Na bhombi bhakamuhekite.
Nambu bhandu pabhapitiki kunja, Yesu akachiheghali chitanda chaka mwali jola, akankamwili chiwoku chaka mwali jola, najombi akajemiki.
Mambu ghanihagha ghakajaghani ku inchi jenijela jokapi.
Yesu abhalamiha akangalola bhabheli
Yesu paakabhokiki pandu panipala, na paakabhi ajenda, akangalola bhabheli bhakanjengalili koni bhakajamalyaje, bhakapwaghaje, “Mwana waka Daude, utubhonila chiha!”
Yesu paakajingi munyumba, bhandu bhabheli bhakanjengalile, najombi akabhalalukile, “Bho, muhobhalela kubha nhweza kundamiha?” Na bhombi bhakamuyangiki, “Ena, Bambo.”
Panihapa Yesu akapapihi mihu ghabhu, akapwagha, “Na ibya kwinu ngati momuhobhalile.”
Palapala mihu ghabhu ghakabhopuliwi. Na jombi Yesu akabhalakalili kwa makili, akapwagha, “Ngamwampwaghi mundu jokapi lijambu lenu.”
Nambu bhombi bhakabhokiki, na kutangaza malobhi ghaka Yesu mu inchi jenijela jokapi.
Yesu andamiha mpuli
Bhandu bhabheli hava pabhakabhokiki, bhandu bhangi bhakundeti Yesu mundu jumu mpuli joakakamuliki na lijobhi.
Chikahi pe lijobhi paakabhowakiki, palapala mundu joakabhi mpuli jola akatumbwi kulongela kabheti. Bhandu bhakakangichi na kupwagha, “Ngachetuliweni lijambu ngati haleli mu inchi jokapi ja Izilaeli!”
Nambu Mafalisayo bhakapwaghiki, “Yesu atopola lijobhi kwa makili ghaka nkolongwa wa lijobhi.”
Yesu abhabhone chiha bhandu

Yesu akayongalwiti mu mbwane na mu hijiji yokapi akabhabhola bhandu mu manyumba gha kuhimanganila Bhayahude, koni akatangaza Malobhi Manyahi gha Ukolongwa waka Chapanga, na kubhalamiha bhandu hitamu yokapi na kulagha kwabhu kwokapi.
Yesu paakaliweni lipogha la bhandu, akabhabhoni chiha, kwa ndandi bhakatondiki na bhakabhi na choghohi na njeta utangatilu, ngati mambeleli ghangakubha na mdima.
Panihapa akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Mahunu nde ghamaheli, nambu bhahenga lihengu nde bhachokope.
Henu mundobha Bambo wa mahunu, apelakaje bhahenga lihengu mu mahunu ghake.”
